title: Only worked on 1/3 of my bottles
text: Only worked on 1/3 of my bottles. Worked fine on Champagne bottles but was too small for Corona beer 32 oz bottles. They are not adjustable. Bought 3 more on a second order and they would not work with any of bottles because the were top large to fit the bottles.

product_metadata.title: Joe Joie Expanding Beverage Bottle Stopper, Pack of 3, Assorted Colors, 1 Pack
features: EASY TO USE – Insert the stopper into the bottle and press the lever to seal the bottle air tight.
AIR-TIGHT SEAL – Stopper produces a leak-proof seal to prolong and preserve opened bottles.
VERSATILE – Use it to seal mineral water, wine, beer, champagne, vinegar, oil, and more.
MATERIALS – The lever is made from plastic and the seal is made from durable rubber.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS – Hand washing is recommended to ensure the longevity of the bottle stopper.
description: Great design for leak-proof and airtight seal Ideal for wine, beer, champagne, mineral water, oil, vinegar Insert in any standard-size bottle Press down the lever to seal in airtight and lock in flavor for freshness To remove the unit, simply pull up the lever to release the airtight seal Colors: Green/Red/Purple Set Includes : 3 Assorted colors of Leak proof expand and seal bottle topper
